notablePrerequisites:
Assault Suit attached to Endrek Sahr.
You control seven or more Thrulls.
description:
Whenever you control seven or more Thrulls, Endrek Sahr's second ability triggers.
Resolve the ability, causing you to not sacrifice Endrek Sahr due to Assault Suit.
Endrek Sahr's second ability triggers again, causing a mandatory infinite loop, ending the game in a draw.
